parameters.text:
=You are a specialized news curator focusing on AI's impact on the publishing, media, and creative industries.

Today's date: {{ $now.toFormat('yyyy-MM-dd') }}
Yesterday's date: {{ $now.minus({days: 1}).toFormat('yyyy-MM-dd') }}

Analyze the following news articles and produce a professional digest following the exact format and rules below.

--- ARTICLES ---
{{ JSON.stringify($json.articles.map(a => ({ title: a.title, description: a.description, url: a.url, publishedAt: a.publishedAt, source: a.source.name })), null, 2) }}
--- END ARTICLES ---

**OUTPUT FORMAT (follow exactly):**

Start with:

🗞️ Headlines (Yesterday)

Include 6–10 ultra-brief headlines (one line each) with links. Prioritize stories from yesterday's date ({{ $now.minus({days: 1}).toFormat('yyyy-MM-dd') }}).

Then provide concise bullet points under these headings:

📚 Authors & AI
Cover: Authors' use of AI in writing, editing, or publishing (e.g., drafting tools, proofreading, public backlash, accidental publication of AI content)

📄 Publishing Contracts & Guidelines
Cover: Publishing contracts or industry guidelines that involve AI use (e.g., clauses about AI in audiobook narration, translation, cover art, AI training rights, disclosure requirements)

🎧 AI Audio & Platform Policy
Cover: How digital platforms are managing AI-generated audio content (e.g., Audible's AI voices, music licensing deals with Suno/Udio, creator backlash, labeling policies)

🎮📽️ Interactive Storytelling & Adaptations
Cover: Book-to-game, book-to-movie/TV, and interactive storytelling developments (including AI-assisted adaptation, interactive fiction platforms, game narrative tools, reader-driven/choice-based storytelling, cross-media IP deals)

**Europe/UK + Rights Marketplace Integration:**
Integrate Europe/UK regulation and rights-marketplace items into the most relevant section(s) above. Topics include: EU AI Act enforcement, UK AI/copyright proposals, CMA/DSA/DMCC platform rules, opt-out schemes, licensing marketplaces, collective management initiatives, scraping restrictions, compensation frameworks. If unclear where to place them, prioritize Publishing Contracts & Guidelines.

**Freshness Rules:**
- PRIORITY: Only include links from yesterday ({{ $now.minus({days: 1}).toFormat('yyyy-MM-dd') }}) whenever available.
- If a section has no qualifying stories from yesterday, add an "Earlier coverage" subsection and group older links by Month YYYY, for example:

  Earlier coverage
    January 2026
    - [headline](url)
    December 2025
    - [headline](url)
  (with bullet points under each month)

**Tone & Style:**
- Professional, reader-friendly, fact-based
- No hype, no speculation
- Always include hyperlinks to original reporting

**Final Section:**

⚡ AI News Ticker (Ultra-Fresh)
- Include 3–7 short bullets for breaking updates from the last 6–12 hours, if available.
- If none are available, write exactly: "No major breaking updates in the last 12 hours."

parameters.content:
📰 AI & Publishing Industry Daily Digest
Automatically search for reputable news about AI's impact on publishing, media, and creative industries, generate a curated digest, and email it to subscribers.

✅ Use Cases
- Publishing professionals tracking AI developments
- Authors monitoring industry changes
- Rights managers staying current on regulation
- Content creators following platform policies

⚙️ Workflow Nodes
Schedule Trigger → NewsAPI (Everything) → AI News Curator Agent → OpenAI GPT-4o → Google Sheets → Gmail

🔑 Setup – Credentials Needed
1. NewsAPI Key → Free account at newsapi.org
2. OpenAI API Key → For GPT-4o news curation
3. Google Sheets OAuth2 → Access subscriber email lists
4. Gmail OAuth2 → Send automated digest emails

📊 Google Sheets Structure Required
Create a subscriber spreadsheet with columns:
- Name (subscriber's name for personalization)
- Email (recipient email addresses)

📋 Digest Sections Covered

📚 Authors & AI
- AI in writing, editing, publishing, drafting tools, proofreading, backlash

📄 Publishing Contracts & Guidelines
- AI clauses in audiobook narration, translation, cover art, training rights, disclosure

🎧 AI Audio & Platform Policy
- Audible AI voices, music licensing (Suno/Udio), creator backlash, labeling

🎮📽️ Interactive Storytelling & Adaptations
- Book-to-game/movie/TV, AI-assisted adaptation, interactive fiction, cross-media IP

🇪🇺🇬🇧 Europe/UK Regulation & Rights Marketplace
- EU AI Act, UK AI/copyright, CMA/DSA/DMCC, opt-out schemes, licensing, scraping
(Integrated into most relevant section; defaults to Publishing Contracts & Guidelines)

⚡ Plus: AI News Ticker for ultra-fresh breaking updates

📅 Schedule
Runs daily at 7:00 AM UTC
Fetches 7-day article window, prioritizes previous calendar day

🗞️ Freshness Rules
- Priority: Yesterday's stories first
- Fallback: Earlier coverage grouped by Month YYYY
- Ultra-fresh ticker for last 6–12 hours

🛠️ Customize It
- Adjust search queries for different topic focus
- Change schedule frequency (daily/weekly)
- Add more news sources beyond NewsAPI
- Switch to HTML emails for richer formatting
- Add Slack/Teams integration for team delivery
- Expand to cover additional creative industries
